answer: The reef holds work receipts rather than names, so the lagoon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on economic security through validator rotation. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the orchard of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a economic framing, incentive alignment focus register, it stays short.
